name: Shell Shockers Better UI
description: Customize your crosshair, see your performance, and keep every match in view. BetterHUD brings the tools together inside Shell Shockers.
title: BetterHUD
summary: A cleaner HUD. A setup that feels like yours.
features: Build, save, import and switch between your crosshair profiles.
Customize FPS and ping displays, HUD elements and effects.
Review live scores and saved matches, with filters and exports.
Choose your region from the home screen with live ping.
settings: Open Shell Shockers Settings, then choose MODS or CROSSHAIR.
note: Match History is included. You do not need the standalone Stats Mod alongside BetterHUD.

name: Shell Shockers Mod Menu
description: Add userscripts, choose a theme, and manage the mods you use from a single in-game menu.
title: Mod Menu
summary: One place for your entire mod setup.
features: Add a script by URL, pasted code or a .user.js file.
Manage supported mods and select one active theme.
Your installed scripts and preferences stay in your browser.
settings: Press the backtick key below Esc, or click the puzzle-piece icon next to the settings gear on the home screen.
note: If Mod Menu runs a script, disable that script's separate Tampermonkey copy. Some changes need a game reload to fully apply or remove.

name: Shell Shockers Stats Mod
description: Keep kills, deaths and KDR from your matches. Revisit scoreboards, filter your history and share the results.
title: Stats Mod
summary: Your matches, beyond the final scoreboard.
features: Review saved matches by map or game mode.
Check kills, deaths and KDR while a match is in progress.
Export JSON or CSV, or save a scoreboard as an image.
settings: Use the round Match History button on the home screen, or set its shortcut in Settings > Keybindings.
note: Already using BetterHUD? Match History is built in. The standalone Stats Mod stays inactive while BetterHUD runs, and both share the same history.

name: Shell Shockers Valorant Sensitivity
description: Set your Valorant sensitivity in Shell Shockers, with separate scoped and ADS multipliers. Keep the same mouse DPI for a consistent setup.
title: Valorant Sensitivity
summary: Bring your familiar sensitivity with you.
features: Set the multipliers you use for aiming and scopes.
Optionally read your Valorant settings. Files stay on your computer.
settings: Open Settings > the keyboard tab. Valorant Sensitivity appears under Mouse Speed. Set the values and press Confirm.
note: Keep your mouse at the same DPI as in Valorant. Conversion behavior is documented by the project.

name: Shell Shockers Gun Sounds
description: Choose gunshots, reloads, melee sounds and empty clicks. Use built-in choices, a meme sound, or a local audio file.
title: Gun Sounds
summary: Give every weapon its own sound.
features: Choose shots and reloads for each primary gun.
Customize pistol, melee, reload and empty-click sounds.
Use local MP3, OGG or WAV files, with volume controls.
settings: Open Settings > the speaker tab > Gun Sounds, under Language and Kill Sounds. Expand the Gun Sounds heading, choose your sounds, then press Confirm.
note: No audio plays on this website. The mod's own volume works alongside the game's Sound Effects volume.

name: Shell Shockers Valorant Kill Sounds
description: Add a sound and banner to each of your kills, rising through your streak. Choose a sound pack or bring your own files.
title: Valorant Kill Sounds
summary: A little more impact with every streak.
features: Sounds and banners step up through your first five kills.
Choose five original packs or fifteen Valorant packs.
Use your own audio and adjust the volume in-game.
settings: Open Settings > the speaker tab > Kill Sounds. Select a pack, use Test, then press Confirm.
note: Works alongside BetterHUD. The effects reflect your own kills and existing game feedback.

name: Shell Shockers Cherry Blossom Theme
description: Pink and plum menus, a blossom loading screen, and drifting petals that step out of the way while you aim.
title: Cherry Blossom
summary: A softer look for your next match.
features: Theme menus, panels, buttons and text fields.
Petals hide during aiming to keep the view clear.
settings: Reload Shell Shockers after installing. The theme applies automatically. Disable it in Tampermonkey and reload to return to the normal theme.
note: Use one theme at a time. Running multiple themes together can mix their colors.

name: Blossom V4 Theme
description: Black and pink menus over cherry blossom art, a pink HUD, and the familiar You blossomed messages, updated for current Shell Shockers.
title: Blossom V4
features: Carry the artwork through menus, popups and the loading screen.
Theme the health bar, crosshair, chat and streak elements.
Your BetterHUD crosshair settings keep priority.
settings: Reload Shell Shockers. The theme applies automatically and can be managed through Tampermonkey or Mod Menu.
note: Use one theme at a time. V4 by Virojet; original Blossom V2/V3 by ThatOneGuySS; original art hosting by Foggier01.

name: Shell Shockers Better UI (sidebar test)
description: An experimental BetterHUD build based on v5.2.3, with a section sidebar in the MODS tab. Intended for testing.
title: BetterHUD Sidebar Test
features: Browse one MODS section at a time.
Tests placement relative to the game's top HUD.
Installs with its own name, alongside the release script.
settings: Disable the regular BetterHUD script before testing, then reload Shell Shockers and open the MODS tab.
note: Experimental and older than the stable release. This build does not auto-update. Do not run it together with the regular BetterHUD script.

name: Hide YouTube Home Feed
description: Keep the desktop YouTube home feed empty while search, subscriptions, channels and video pages remain available.
title: Hide YouTube Home Feed
summary: Open YouTube with a little more intention.
features: Hide home recommendations, Shorts shelves and promotions.
Search, subscriptions, channels and video pages remain available.
Runs on the desktop website through your userscript manager.
settings: Reload an open desktop YouTube tab, then open the home page. Search for a video to verify that search remains available.
note: Desktop YouTube only. The mobile website and native apps are not supported.
